message.content:
The Velvet-Black Wrap Blazer, structured fit with wide lapels, knee-length, #0A0A0A velvet; the Midnight-Gold Pleated Trouser, tailored high-rise cut, full length, #1C1814 silk blend.

The Obsidian-Stiletto Pump, pointed toe, ankle-height, #0F0F0F patent leather.

The Champagne-Edelweiss Drop Earring, classic drop silhouette, small, #E8D6C5 sterling silver and cubic zirconia; the Frosted-Mist Cashmere Scarf, rectangular loose drape, collar-length, #D8D3CE cashmere.

This outfit works perfectly for an upscale New Year's party because the velvet blazer provides the necessary richness and warmth required by the frosty autumn weather while adhering to her refusal of outer layers only when needed. The deep black tones against the warm gold accents create a sophisticated contrast that fits both smart and formal dress codes without appearing too casual or overly severe. The luxurious fabrics like silk blend and cashmere ensure comfort during the evening celebration, allowing her to move gracefully through the restaurant while looking polished and festive.
